author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, from my own measurement: on akiendell `bin/cairn artifact remove <path>` on a sealed validation (bin/validations/test_cairn_resolves_from_powershell.json) fails at artifact.py remove(): p.unlink() raises PermissionError WinError 5, because the validation store writes seals read-only (-r--r--r--) and Windows will not unlink a read-only file. The door that exists to remove records cannot remove a seal on Windows. Fix: clear the read-only bit (os.chmod with stat.S_IWRITE) before the unlink, on every OS; the store's read-only mode is deliberate and is not changed.
